summary: Linux-only native distribution (D47) at candidate dee7d4e59f, the head of lane/linux-only-distribution, which branched from develop bfce3d9249: five lane commits from 4d877d34ab to 246d691ff1 (packing and assembly limited to linux-x64 and linux-arm64, installers refusing macOS and Windows before any download, canonical SemVer in a total order with Linux-only updates in bake-update, a glibc floor check, and an ubuntu-24.04-arm CI job requiring the Linux sandbox backends and kernel fault checks), then the review-fix commit dee7d4e59f (bake-update's fixture builds its updater with Updater::for_target so its suite runs on every host, glibc-floor.ts runs readelf in the C locale, fails closed on output it cannot read, and defaults to GLIBC_2.34 by D50, the image gate refuses any macOS or Windows archive whatever its flags, and both installers order versions by one shared case table). The 0.4 Linux integration merged it at d053bac402 and added integration fix 79fe7b2f77, which declares that shared table, scripts/release/fixtures/native-version-order.txt, a bake-update input in scripts/rust-scope.ts; without it rust-scope.test.ts fails, so the candidate alone would not pass scripts-unit. Evidence is one Linux x86_64 host, this Fedora Linux 44 machine: a workspace nextest run at d0c1891829 (all six lanes merged, before 79fe7b2f77 and the integration's docs), 3190 cases all passed with 8 skipped, whose saved log holds only its summary and no exit status, so no result cites it; and the full Linux preflight at the integration head 3421fd94ce, 39 gates passed with actionlint skipped. Its gates ran bake-update's 55 tests among 3092 nextest cases (all passed, 8 skipped, plus the codemode harness's 98), 944 Bun script tests with 17 skipped and none failed, the native pack test (5 passed, 1 skipped: the off-Linux refusal case), and the native install rehearsal (1 passed: the log reads installed 0.4.0-dev (linux-x64) from bake-v0.4.0-dev-linux-x64.tar.gz, then the fixture 0.4.1-dev). The install.ps1 checks were skipped there for want of pwsh. The preflight log names the commit and umask 022; the orchestrating session reports BAKE_REQUIRE_KERNEL_FAULTS=1 and BAKE_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_BACKENDS=bwrap,landlock and a clean tree, which the log does not record. No fixture source below differs between the candidate and 3421fd94ce. The packaging gates' logs record no archive hash. The fix worker's controls left no logs, and one of its mutations survived as equivalent on the table. This is the first scope 16 record of the Rust distribution and supersedes nothing. An aarch64 run, release.yml and the distribution guide's GitHub Actions sections narrowed to the two Linux platforms, the owner's signing key, the Linux rehearsal against final archives, and reviewer acceptance are missing.

results.behavior: bake-update passed in the rust-test gate, 43 unit and 12 integration tests. version::tests::a_release_version_is_canonical_semantic_versioning, numeric_identifiers_compare_by_value_at_any_size, versions_order_by_semantic_precedence, text_that_is_not_a_release_version_still_orders_without_panicking, and the_shared_case_table_is_in_ascending_order, with the proptests under version::tests::properties (release_versions_are_equal_only_when_they_are_the_same_text, version_order_is_transitive, any_two_candidates_order_antisymmetrically, a_version_with_a_leading_zero_or_an_empty_identifier_is_refused, and three more), make release versions canonical SemVer in a strict total order. manifest::tests::native_updates_are_published_for_the_two_linux_platforms_alone and update::tests::an_updater_is_made_only_for_a_release_platform, which injects the host platform, refuse macOS and Windows; tests/update.rs::the_fixture_updates_every_manifest_platform_on_every_host builds its updater with Updater::for_target so the suite runs on every host. bake-cli's update::tests::without_an_install_a_platform_outside_the_release_says_when_updates_arrive passed. Counts describe nextest test cases.

The scripts-unit gate passed 944 Bun tests with 17 skipped across 66 files, among them glibc-floor.test.ts (readelf parsed in the C locale, a static binary needing nothing, output it cannot read failing closed, weak needs above the floor not failing it, and, since the log prints no skip note for them, the built-binary checks against a bake under rust/target, whose floor the log does not name), native-install.test.ts (install.sh refusing versions other than canonical SemVer and ordering versions as bake-update does over the shared case table), native-manifest.test.ts (complete mode needs exactly linux-arm64 and linux-x64, and a macOS or Windows archive is refused by name whatever the flags), assemble-rust.test.ts, pack-rust.test.ts, and rust-scope.test.ts, which passes with 79fe7b2f77's entry. Bun prints per-file totals only, so the log names no passing test.

pack-rust.native.ts passed 5 tests with 1 skipped, the case that a host outside the 0.4.0 release set is refused before building, which runs only off Linux; it includes that the packed bake unpacks and runs without Node, Bun, or a usable Bake home. native-rehearsal.native.ts passed: the checkout's real debug bake, archived in pack-rust.ts's layout and published to a loopback host with an ephemeral key, was installed by the shipped install.sh as 0.4.0-dev for linux-x64 from bake-v0.4.0-dev-linux-x64.tar.gz and ran its own --self-check, then a fixture 0.4.1-dev followed it so previous names the real release. Its license bundle files are placeholders, and an update and rollback driven by bake update itself are outside it.
install.ps1 refuses at its start for install, --uninstall-links, an unknown option, and irm | iex, refuses non-canonical versions, and orders versions over the shared case table.

One mutation survived: install.sh's awk length comparison made numeric, which is equivalent on the case table. The lane worker reports bun run mutants:rust on version.rs (29 caught, 0 missed, 3 unviable) and misses in manifest.rs only in older code. No output, exit status, or tree was saved.

evalRecords.notApplicable: No model-visible change: packaging, installers, the glibc check, CI, and bake update change no prompt, tool, result, context, or loop. The only user-facing Rust text change is bake update's message on a platform outside the release.

rollback.observed: bake-update's integration tests serve releases from a loopback HTTP fixture the test owns, signed with an ephemeral Ed25519 key pair, and check that every refused update, held lock, interrupted switch, and failed candidate leaves the working install byte for byte as it was. The installer tests run the scripts against a release host fixture that records every request, with a stand-in uname for the platform refusal, in temporary directories they own; the pack and rehearsal tests build and install into temporary roots. No user home or real install is touched. The preflight log opens with its commit and umask 022 and records no git status; the orchestrating session reports the tree clean.

review.missing: No reviewer has accepted scope 16. The orchestrating session's review agents reviewed the lane and a fix worker fixed their findings in dee7d4e59f; that is not scope acceptance.
